meta.title: Nintendo Switch Sports Resort – Nintendo Switch 2 Exclusive - Nintendo Official Site
meta.description: Get moving in Nintendo Switch Sports Resort, a Nintendo Switch 2 exclusive. Play 12 motion-control sports including Bowling, Basketball, and Skateboarding.

assets.alt: Various sportsmates animating across the screen showing some of the sports you can play in the game—tennis, archery, skateboarding, basketball and boxing.

asset.alt: The logo for Nintendo Switch Sports Resort.

modules.heading: Face off in 12 motion-control sports on an island getaway!

content.value: Welcome to Spocco Resort! Dive into a variety of sports with intuitive motion controls that make it easy for anyone to pick up. Play casually with friends*, on your own, or turn up the heat in the ranked online** Pro League. From fast-paced matches to secret island surprises, there are plenty of ways to play, connect, and explore.
Exclusively for the Nintendo Switch™ 2 system

modules.alt: The Nintendo Switch Sports Resort bundle box featuring both the game itself and the Nintendo Switch 2 System.

content.value: The trailer for Nintendo Switch Sports Resort, showcasing gameplay of motion controlled spots like bowling, tennis, archery, skateboarding, prop planing and more.

modules.alt: A family of four using the Joy Con 2 controllers as they use motion control to play one of the various sports in the game.

modules.text: Gameplay featuring a two adults racing on Power Cruisers that then cuts into a family of four going head to head in tennis.

modules.heading: Get a friendly rivalry going—and the whole family moving

content.value: Enjoy classic sports including Archery, Basketball, Boxing, and Tennis, along with new ones like Skateboarding and Thumb Wrestling. Play ‘em solo or with friends—online or on the same system.

modules.alt: A group of various different sportsmates in an action shot of their chosen sport.

content.value: It’s easy to share the fun! Up to four people can play offline on the same Nintendo Switch 2 system using Joy-Con 2 or Joy-Con controllers.

assets.alt: A sports mate preparing to spike a volleyball.
A family of four in various mid-movement poses as they play Nintendo Switch Sports Resort.

modules.heading: Explore Wuhu Island by land, sea, and air

content.value: Take in scenic views as you uncover sightseeing spots in different ways: Power Cruise through the open water, Skateboard across the resort, or fly through the sky in a Prop Plane.

assets.alt: A plane cruising through the clouds.
A sports mate cruising past a car while riding a skateboard.
A split screen of a plane gracefully arching over a cityscape and a plane gliding close to the water.
assets.caption: Split screen gameplay of two sports mates flying toward a cityscape in the game.

assets.alt: Gameplay of a female sports mate grinding a skateboard over a bridge, landing a stunt and making it past the goal posts before time runs out.
assets.caption: Gameplay of a sports mate skateboarding throughout the city.

content.value: Discover the island on a Sightseeing Tour as you complete challenges, collect Spocco Photos, and more.
Race against your friends’ times or your personal best through various courses in Skateboarding and Power Cruising. Or fly into a Ball Battle in Prop Plane for a friendly rivalry among the clouds.
3 Discover island secrets in Sightseeing Mode as you complete challenges, collect Spocco Photos, and unlock additional starting locations.

assets.alt: A sports mate wearing aviator gear flying in a plane.
A male sports mate showing character customization with blue hair
A female Mii avatar stretching her arms.
A female sports mate wearing a bucket hat and stretching her arm across her body.

modules.heading: Play as a Sportsmate or Mii character

asset.alt: The customization screen showing the outfits and accessories button selected. To the right stands a female sports mate wearing a bucket hat.

content.value: Create and customize your character’s look to capture your personal style! Get artsy, go funky, or get weird with a variety of hairstyles, outfits, accessories, and Body Types. Save your favorite looks and swap between ‘em whenever you want.

asset.alt: The hair customization options with a specific hairstyle and color selected. To the right is a female sports mate with pink and blue hair.

content.value: Earn Spocco Points as you play, then use them to snag more cosmetic options from weekly and monthly collections in the Item Center!

asset.alt: Character customization options at the Item Center showcasing new options for sports mates.

modules.heading: What’s new at the Item Center

content.value: Customize your Sportsmate with two item collections in game each week, with new themed items arriving every month!
Find the cameras!

modules.alt: A young woman using Joy Con 2 as she gets ready to serve in tennis.

content.value: Rally and score in Tennis as you use your Joy-Con™ 2 controller like a racket. Play a regular 6- or 11-point game on one of three courts in Match. Or play a singles match with a giant tennis ball that can be hit easily in Laid-Back Match.

assets.alt: A pairs tennis match showing one player delivery a point scoring serve.
assets.caption: Gameplay of a pairs tennis match.

modules.name: pmp_taylor - Sports Section - List - Tennis - Labels

modules.alt: A young woman holding a Joy Con 2 controller and releasing a shot.

content.value: Hit the court in four different modes! Dribble, pass, steal, and shoot in regular two-on-two matches. Score as many three-point shots as you can in 80 seconds in Three-Point Challenge, or see who can score the most three-pointers in a timed Three-Point Contest. Challenge yourself in a Five-Streak Battle and try to score five three-point shots in a row within 60 seconds. But if you miss a shot, your progress gets reset to zero! (No pressure.)

assets.alt: The player jumping up to score a basket.
assets.caption: Gameplay of a basketball game showing the player jumping up to shoot a basket.

items.heading: Up to 4 (Match), 1 (Three-Point Challenge), 2-4 Players (Three-Point Contest and Five-Streak Battle)

modules.name: pmp_taylor - Sports Section - List - Basketball - Labels

modules.alt: A young man holding an outstretched arm with the Joy Con 2 controller as he takes a shot in archery.

content.value: Bullseye! Aim and shoot at 12 ranges in two different modes. In Standard, aim for the center of the target and score as many points as you can. In Special, the target is split into four quadrants, each with its own color. Line up your shot, hit your own color, and avoid scoring for your opponents by accidentally hitting their quadrants!

assets.alt: A split screen showing two players getting ready to aim an arrow at a target on a beach.
assets.caption: Split screen gameplay showing two sportsmates aiming and releasing an arrow at a target.

modules.name: pmp_taylor - Sports Section - List - Archery - Labels

modules.alt: A young woman slightly crouching as she releases a powerful bowl in bowling.

content.value: Rule the lanes! Test your skills in Standard Bowling, mix things up with obstacle-filled lanes in Special Bowling, or chase a perfect 3,000-point game in 100-Pin Game. Then raise the stakes in Survival Bowling as you square off against up to 16 players to be the last one standing. In each mode, use the Joy-Con 2 controller to aim, roll, and rack up strikes.

assets.alt: A transparent sports mate releasing a bowling ball down a bowling lane.
assets.caption: A transparent sport smate aiming and releasing a bowling ball, resulting in a strike.

modules.name: pmp_taylor - Sports Section - List - Bowling - Labels

modules.alt: A young man smiles as he punches his fist forward as a sports mate's hand extends from the Joy Con 2 controller.

content.value: Hold and tilt the Joy-Con 2 controller to pin your opponent’s thumb for three seconds in this best-of-three sport. Risk taking time powering up your thumb to pin your opponent more easily, or pin them multiple times to make it harder for them to break free.

assets.alt: A male and female sports mate going thumb to thumb in a thumb wrestling match.
assets.caption: Split screen gameplay of a male and female sports mate going thumb to thumb in a thumb wrestling match.

modules.name: pmp_taylor - Sports Section - List - Thumb Wrestling - Labels

modules.alt: A young person holding the Joy Con 2 controller in both hands as they swing it forward in Golf.

content.value: Choose your club, plan out your swing, and aim for a hole-in-one! Take your stance as you hold the Joy-Con 2 controller like a club, note the wind speed and direction, wind up, then gently swing forward. Try for the lowest possible score on 27 holes!

assets.alt: A sports mate swinging their golf club toward a golf ball.
assets.caption: Gameplay of a sports mate making a swing and sending a golf ball flying.

modules.name: pmp_taylor - Sports Section - List - Golf - Labels

modules.alt: An older man punching his left arm forward as a sports mate's boxing glove covers his hands.

content.value: Use your Joy-Con 2 controllers to punch, dodge, and block your way to glory in the ring! Duke it out with your opponent and try to counter their attacks. Win by decision after three rounds or see if you can knock ‘em out for the win.

assets.alt: Two sports mates duking it out in the boxing ring.
assets.caption: Split screen gameplay of two sports mates going toe-to-toe in a boxing match.

modules.name: pmp_taylor - Sports Section - List - Boxing - Labels

modules.alt: A young man laughs as he uses the Mouse mode on the Joy Con 2 controller to skateboard.

content.value: Use your Joy-Con 2 controller like a mouse to grind rails, pull off tricks, and shred across Wuhu Island. Take off on a Sightseeing Tour as you collect coins, complete missions, and hunt for Spocco Photos. Race your friends through various courses in Skate Sprint. Or skate wherever you’d like without time limits or objectives in Free Play.

assets.alt: A sports mate grinding and stunning on a rail in the skatepark.
assets.caption: Gameplay of a sports mate grinding on a rail as they stunt throughout a skatepark.

modules.name: pmp_taylor - Sports Section - List - Skateboarding - Labels

modules.alt: A young woman bracing herself to counter a serve in table tennis.

content.value: Get a rally going! Use one Joy-Con 2 controller like a paddle and deliver precise hits that speed up the ball or add spin to trip up your opponent. Play a traditional match or make as many returns as possible before time runs out in a Return Challenge.

assets.alt: Two sports mates facing off over table tennis.
assets.caption: Gameplay of two sports mates going back and forth over a game of table tennis.

modules.name: pmp_taylor - Sports Section - List - Table Tennis - Labels

modules.alt: A kid pushes forward the Joy Con 2 controller alongside an image of a prop plane.

content.value: Soak up dreamy resort views in three different modes. In Sightseeing Tour, explore Wuhu Island from the sky as you shoot balloons, complete missions, and hunt for Spocco Photos. Start up a Ball Battle and try to collect more balls than your opponents in this multiplayer mode. Or shift into a more leisurely pace in Free Play where you can explore the island without time limits or objectives.

assets.alt: A split screen of two sports mates flying in prop planes.
assets.caption: Split screen gameplay of two sports mates flying a prop plane and flying into bubbles to get more points.

modules.name: pmp_taylor - Sports Section - List - Prop Plane - Labels

modules.alt: A young woman holds two Joy Con 2 controllers mimicking the moment of Power Cruising.

content.value: Speed off on a Sightseeing Tour as you explore landmarks around Wuhu Island to collect coins, complete missions, and hunt for Spocco Photos. Compete against your friends’ times or personal best as you race through various courses in Sea Sprint. Or go for a leisurely cruise in Free Play without time limits or objectives.

assets.alt: A split screen of two sports mates racing against each other on power cruisers.
assets.caption: Spit Screen gameplay showing two sports mates racing against each other on power cruisers.

modules.name: pmp_taylor - Sports Section - List - Power Cruising - Labels

modules.alt: A young man holds the Joy Con 2 controller as he prepares to spike a volleyball.

content.value: Hold and move your Joy-Con 2 controller to bump, set, and spike your way to victory. Play with regular Volleyball rules in Match or try for a perfect score by bumping the ball in time with the music in Bump to the Beat.

assets.alt: A sports mate preparing to spike a volleyball.
assets.caption: Gameplay showing four sports mates playing a volleyball game.

modules.name: pmp_taylor - Sports Section - List - Volleyball - Labels

content.value: Bring your A-game in this single-player-focused mode! Take on the Island Champions and Legends—including formidable Mii™ character Matt—across nine different sports. Earn customization options and Spocco Points as you play your way to the top.

assets.alt: A group of 12 Island Champions striking various poses.
An older male sports mate punches his fist forward as if landing a punch in boxing.
A girl sports mates jumping mid air as her arm moves back to launch the ball toward a basket.

modules.alt: An hand holding the Joy Con 2 controller extending over a banner featuring the symbols of the playable sports.

modules.heading: Climb the ranks in Island Crown
Compete with friends and family online

content.value: Host or join a private lobby with as many as eight players, with up to two players on each system. Pick from a variety of sports and let the games begin!

assets.alt: A dad celebrates as his daughter uses the Joy Con 2 controller in mouse mode.

content.value: Banter, cheer, and explore the island together, anytime, anywhere***.
Put your skills to the test without the pressure of ranked results. Choose from nine sports and enjoy relaxed matches with players worldwide.

assets.alt: A young woman leaning forward as if bowling.

content.value: Challenge players from around the world in the online Pro League! Go head-to-head with competitors who match your skill level as you vie for the top spot.

assets.alt: Two friends standing side by side as they swipe their Joy Con 2 controllers forward in a game of tennis.

content.value: Nintendo Switch Online membership required.

asset.alt: The Nintendo Switch Sports Resort and Nintendo Switch 2 system bundle.

modules.heading: Kick off your island sports adventure with a bundle

content.value: Get everything you need to play right away—and save**** $27.98 on a Nintendo Switch 2 system with a full download of the Nintendo Switch Sports Resort game and a 3-month Nintendo Switch Online***** Individual Membership.

Product:{\"sku\":\"7100125145\"}.description({\"html\":true}):
Gently swing your racket, pull back and aim like an archer, and much more in 12 sports with intuitive motion controls*. Move together in sports like Bowling and Basketball, duke it out in Boxing, battle with one thumb to hand your opponent a defeat in Thumb Wrestling—there are lots of ways to compete and have fun together, online** or offline***!

You can test your skills against players from around the world in Pro League, play without the pressure of rankings in Casual Online Play, or get up to eight friends together to play a variety of sports with an online Friend Lobby.

Create and customize your Sportsmate or Mii™ characters, and use the Spocco Points you earn as you play to unlock cosmetic options for them in the Item Center!

Explore the Wuhu Island resort getaway in Sightseeing Tour

Steer across the waves in Power Cruising, tilt the controller to fly around freely in Prop Plane, or ride around the island with Joy-Con™ 2 mouse controls in Skateboarding. Explore at your choice of three different times of day in all three modes to collect Spocco Photos and complete missions. Have fun exploring the resort!

Climb the ranks to challenge the champion in Island Crown

Challenge increasingly tough opponents as you try to climb from 20th place to 1st in the rankings. Rumor has it that if you become a truly elite competitor, you’ll get a chance to face off against the island Legend. You can also get additional cosmetic options by achieving certain ranks in this mode!
